span.term: Antidromic activation of layer 5 corticotectal cells whose axons cross the shell stimulation site, feeding back through their intracortical collaterals to generate the layer 1 sink
span.note: status: the paper's own words: it is possible that
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The alternative explanation for the shell slice layer 1 sink (antidromically activated layer 5 corticotectal cells) cannot be excluded
span.note: what this limits: the layer 1 sink interpretation: IT DOES NOT PROVE THAT THIS HYPOTHETICAL MODE OF ACTIVATION ACTUALLY OCCURS OR THAT DIRECT INPUT FROM THE NONPRIMARY AUDITORY THALAMUS HAD NO ROLE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because of that unresolved alternative, the authors advise caution in using the shell preparation
span.note: what this limits: any use of the shell preparation while the alternative is unresolved: THUS AT PRESENT IT SHOULD BE USED WITH CAUTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The pharmacological design cannot isolate the AMPA/KA contribution, since APV was never given alone
span.note: what this limits: any AMPA/KA conclusion from the pharmacology: THIS SUBTRACTIVE LOGIC CANNOT BE USED TO IMPLICATE AMPA/KA RECEPTORS BECAUSE APV WAS NEVER APPLIED BY ITSELF
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The synaptic order of the early response is unresolved
span.note: what this limits: the synaptic order of the early response: EXACTLY HOW MANY LINKS ARE INVOLVED IN THE EARLY RESPONSE REMAINS TO BE DETERMINED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A measured quantity is stated not to be comparable across studies, because its visibility depends on method and criteria.
span.note: what this limits: any comparison of IPSP amplitudes between this study and another: the authors state it is difficult to compare IPSPs across studies because the degree to which they can be observed, and their amplitudes, depends heavily on methodology and criteria
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The conventional stimulation method is stated to be possibly unreliable for the purpose it is used for.
span.note: what this limits: any result attributing a response to thalamocortical input on the basis of columnar stimulation: the authors state their MG-evoked profiles differ from those produced by conventional columnar stimulation, which may not be a reliable means of selectively activating thalamocortical inputs
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Two stimulation sites are reported not to activate the same synapses, with different laminar profiles.
span.note: what this limits: any treatment of on-beam and MG stimulation as interchangeable probes: they are stated not to activate the same sets of synapses in cortex, and to evoke different laminar profiles
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The AMPA/KA conclusion is conditional on an assumption the authors state is difficult to prove.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that AMPA/KA receptors mediate transmission at these synapses: it follows if one assumes the fast EPSP in the middle layers is a monosynaptic event, and the authors state it is difficult to prove that a response is monosynaptic
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Whether the preparation's evoked activation resembles the intact system is stated to be undetermined.
span.note: what this limits: any inference from these evoked responses to sound-driven cortical activity: the authors state it remains to be determined whether the activation produced by MG stimulation represents a natural pattern similar to that produced by acoustic stimulation in vivo
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Inhibition may be incompletely developed at the age used, indicated by the marker staining in this material.
span.note: what this limits: any absolute inhibitory strength taken from these recordings: cortical inhibitory systems are known not to be fully developed in juvenile rodents, and the modest cortical PV labeling observed here is stated to indicate it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: on-beam and MG-evoked IPSPs compared DIRECTLY WITHIN THE SAME SLICES rather than across the preparation
span.note: eliminates: preparation-dependent differences - slice health, cutting angle, anything that varies between preparations and would otherwise be read as a difference between the two pathways
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a re-analysis restricted to the SEVEN CELLS in which MG-evoked EPSPs were at least as strong as on-beam EPSPs
span.note: eliminates: weaker MG excitation as the explanation of weaker MG inhibition - if the thalamic pathway simply drove the slice less hard, smaller IPSPs would follow with no difference in inhibition itself
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an IPSP amplitude, across papers - NOT A COMPARABLE QUANTITY: whether an IPSP can be observed at all, and how large it is, depends heavily on methodology and criteria, so the same named measurement in two studies is two measurements and the authors state the comparison is difficult
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: columnar (on-beam) stimulation - NOT A SELECTIVE THALAMOCORTICAL PROBE: it is used to activate thalamocortical inputs, and the authors state it may not be a reliable means of doing so selectively, because MG and on-beam stimuli do not activate the same sets of synapses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the AMPA/KA finding - HELD UP BY AN ASSUMPTION, NOT A CONTROL: the subtractive logic could not be used because APV was never applied alone, so the conclusion follows only if the fast EPSP is a monosynaptic event, which the authors state is difficult to prove
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the early IPSPs - CORTICAL IN ROUTE, INFERRED FROM A BLOCKER RATHER THAN FROM THE RESPONSE: a direct inhibitory thalamic projection is ruled out because an AMPA/KA antagonist blocked them, and the remaining account is that excitatory thalamic projections drove cortical interneurons which then synapsed on the recorded cells; the paper states this as likely, not as shown
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A mouse brain slice can be cut in a near-horizontal plane that preserves a functionally intact thalamocortical pathway from the ventral medial geniculate to auditory cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Auditory thalamocortical transmission is carried by both AMPA/kainate and NMDA glutamate receptors.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Every primary slice analysed showed a dominant current sink in cortical layers 3-4 after medial geniculate stimulation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Responses evoked by thalamic stimulation differ from those evoked by conventional columnar (white matter/layer 6) stimulation, so columnar stimulation is not a reliable proxy for thalamocortical activation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A second, more ventral 'shell' slice was introduced in which subcortical stimulation selectively activates synapses in superficial layer 1 of temporal cortex.
